purpose: Prepare a visible, unaccepted reconsideration draft when a root pull request changes a source that a recorded decision of this repository cites.
applicability: The recorded decisions in docs/integration-contract-decisions.md and the repository files they link to, at exact commits. A person reviews every draft; nothing is applied automatically.

rubric.state:
e1: (the changed region of a cited source)
e2: (the recorded decision)

impact.instructions: Does the change to the cited source (e1) affect the recorded decision (e2)? Keep both texts regardless of the answer.

criteria.affected: The change modifies or removes lines of a source the decision cites.
criteria.unaffected: The change only adds lines to the cited source.
